value.name: Micky stands up
value.description: Micky rises from his seat as the confrontation around him escalates.

value.name: Charlene pulls Micky back down
value.description: Charlene physically stops Micky from getting up by pulling him back into his seat.

value.name: Micky warns against getting hurt
value.description: Micky's companion warns him not to get hurt before the fight as the situation turns tense.
evidence: Don't, Micky! I don't want ya gettin' hurt before the fight!

value.name: Others rush out after Alice
value.description: Alice, George, Red Dog, and Sherry leave the restaurant, abandoning Micky and Charlene behind.
evidence: He rushes out after Alice, George, Red Dog, Sherry leaving Micky and Charlene behind.

value.name: Screams and sirens intensify
value.description: The chaos outside grows louder, with sirens and screams filling the street.
evidence: Hear more SIRENS, SCREAMS from the street.

value.name: Micky tries to get up again
value.description: Unable to tolerate the commotion, Micky jumps up from his seat again.
evidence: Micky can't take it, jumps up.

value.name: Charlene orders Micky to sit down
value.description: Charlene angrily tells Micky to sit down and stay put.
evidence: Sit down. Are you kiddin' me? Are you Are you for real? Sit down. serious? Sit down, sit. Sit down.

value.name: Charlene grabs Micky's pants
value.description: Charlene physically restrains Micky by grabbing the back of his pants as he tries to move away.
evidence: She grabs the back of his pants.. .he drags her a little, pushes her hand off

value.name: Micky pushes Charlene away
value.description: Micky breaks Charlene's grip and leaves her reaching out after him.
evidence: pushes her hand off, leaves her outstretched, hair fallen over her face.
